hooks.command: sh -c 's=; case "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" in /*) s=$(cd -P -- "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P);; esac; a="$HOME/.config/panopticon/primaries"; r=; [ -n "$HOME" ] && [ -n "$s" ] && [ -r "$a" ] && while IFS= read -r p || [ -n "$p" ]; do case "$p" in /*) ;; *) continue;; esac; p=$(cd -P -- "$p" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || continue; case "$s" in "$p"|"$p"/.claude/worktrees/*) r=$p; break;; esac; done < "$a"; [ -n "$r" ] || { echo "Blocked by Warden launcher: this session directory is not under a trusted primary checkout. Ask Krzysztof to run wardens sync." >&2; exit 2; }; [ -f "$r/wardens/dist/wardens.mjs" ] || { echo "Blocked by Warden launcher: the Wardens bundle of the trusted primary checkout is missing. Run pnpm --filter wardens build in the primary checkout." >&2; exit 2; }; exec node "$r/wardens/dist/wardens.mjs" hook --tool claude --event SessionStart'
